The notorious Bandit and his beautiful companion, Carrie, find themselves involved in a mission of epic proportions: transporting a pregnant elephant cross-country in 24 hours or less! Hot on their heels is archenemy Sheriff Buford T. Justice, who vows to finally put the Bandit behind bars.
